observer_hook: External context-managed wrapper of _search_symbolic_programs; capture only outer call. Original function and return value preserved.

noninterference.tolerance: exact equality; fail on any drift
noninterference.unchecked_diagnostics: Additional pre-search and proof-cache observations absent from baseline are not claimed as independent before/after measurements

counting.winner_first_failure: separate exclusive diagnostic ordering, total 462; not claimed as evaluator short-circuit order
counting.unmet_proofs: separate winner/public, gold-flat and beam scopes; unique per example/name/state within scope; overlap allowed
counting.gold_flat_scope: serialized dataset operation, may use legacy ADD/SUM3/SUM4; do not equate its proof contract to logical SUM_N beam programs
